groups.name: coverage identity aliases valid and invalid declarations
groups.actual: Each control first wrote a genuinely qualified offline report/cache. The direct qualifier rejected the subsequently invalid declaration, but update_report reused an eligible cached row. Missing versus explicit null used the same get() identity; JSON serialization also equated valid list and invalid tuple.
groups.scope: Actual live cache bypass reproduced. The analogous champion-history get() identity collision was read in source, not separately asserted by these tests.

groups.name: presentation/harvest columns can replace qualification declarations
groups.actual: Direct qualification of the original policy rejected the missing explicit column or missing actual metric. The real offline report instead qualified after replacing columns from metric_harvest, including an actual alternate source file.
groups.scope: Offline/legacy live reporting route only; the native-authority branch already passed the original policy.

groups.name: declared column validation runs after unsafe iteration
groups.actual: The real direct qualifier raised TypeError while iterating columns=1 before its declaration ValueError handling, instead of returning dataset_coverage_declaration_invalid.
